event_chain.summary: Qilin leak-site listing with document samples

summary: Between January 17 and 20, 2026 an unauthorized party accessed and took files from the computer system of the Tulsa Airports Improvement Trust, which runs Tulsa International Airport. The trust discovered the breach on January 20, secured its network and hired a forensic firm. The Qilin ransomware gang claimed the attack in early February and posted document samples on its leak site. The files held names with addresses, phone numbers, Social Security numbers, driver's license or other ID numbers, and bank routing and account numbers.
